Outro with one call to action

The critical situation: who, where, what happened (sourced)
Why it matters for the listener
What could go wrong next
The correct response: what to do instead
The one message of the post

educational, promotional or campaign

In German: the core message, at most 8 words
Exactly 3 English bullets, one per line: each starts with a verb, a benefit or action, at most 6 words, no quotes, no tool jargon
One icon per bullet, one per line, from the allowed list

Optional: the stat badge's label, one line
